name: s100
spec: Roadmap 7526d614e5, Test VL: does night 1 hurt skills less with each record seen fewer times (arm V) or at a lower lr (arm L)? CPU. Reads the skills TRAIN file (replay), C2 pool / warm rows (night records),
recipe: night 2 = SCM2's night 2 (from SCM, frozen copy = SCM, lr 3e-4, SCM2's update count = number of night-2 records, seed s2, same model-picked skills replay, warm rows and pick settings; the replay / pick draws are the same as SCM2's) with ONE change: the record half of each batch is drawn (balanced epoch-wise shuffles) from night 1's records PLUS night 2's records (ids prefixed n1| / n2| on copies, targets registered from each night's own snapshot)

marks_rules.mark1_first_try: (1) pooled C2 DEV first try: c2_pilot.boot(APM right, SCM2 right) point >= +2.0
marks_rules.mark2_multi_step: (2) multi-step first try (HARD_KINDS, 154 questions): APM - SCM2 point >= -2.0
marks_rules.mark3_night2_cost: (3) night 2's own cost: harm_measure(SCM DEV hits, APM DEV hits) passes (in_dist drop <= 1.5, no family fires)
marks_rules.passes: passes = (1) and (2) and (3) on BOTH parents (s100, s101)
marks_rules.proved_wrong: the APM - SCM2 pooled first-try paired 95% interval has its upper end < +1.0 on BOTH parents (decided in the report)

note: C2 pool / warm rows / DEV and skills train / DEV only; test / labelled / K_new never opened; the pick uses only skills TRAIN rows and the model's own losses

records1.source: from S1 day /root/c7d/s1/s100/day.pkl (1023 rows); 1 greedy-passing rows searched here (seed 2000)
